title: MitoSpace: Self-Supervised 4D Live-Cell Microscopy Foundation Model Maps Organelle Form to Function
aiSystem: MitoSpace (4D Contrastive Representation Foundation Model, UC San Diego)
whyItMatters: Published in Cell, MitoSpace trained without labels on terabytes of 4D lattice light-sheet movies to predict mitochondrial membrane potential (R² = 0.91) from dynamics alone and generalize zero-shot to human lung organoids.
summary: Published in Cell on September 10, 2026 (Vol. 189, Issue 19, pp. 5962–5979.e6, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2026.08.028, PMID 42721963), Dhruv Agarwal, Zichen Wang, Eric Arkfeld, Johannes Schöneberg, and colleagues at UC San Diego introduced MitoSpace—the first self-supervised 4D live-cell microscopy foundation model. Trained without human labels on terabytes of volumetric time-lapse (x, y, z, t) lattice light-sheet microscopy movies of mitochondria under mechanistically distinct drug perturbations, MitoSpace learns interpretable spatiotemporal representations that beat hand-crafted morphological features in mechanism-of-action classification. Simple regression probes on MitoSpace embeddings predict single-cell mitochondrial membrane potential directly from unlabeled 4D morphology and dynamics with R² = 0.91, establishing a quantitative single-cell form-to-function law. Dimensionality ablations proved monotonic gains from 2D to 3D to 4D, and the pretrained model generalized zero-shot to unseen chemical perturbations and complex human lung organoids.
technicalHighlights: Trained self-supervised on terabytes of 4D (3D + time) lattice light-sheet microscopy movies, outperforming hand-engineered features on drug mechanism-of-action classification.
Predicts single-cell mitochondrial membrane potential purely from learned 4D structural/dynamic representations at R² = 0.91, quantifying live organelle form-to-function mapping.
Generalizes zero-shot to unseen perturbations and human lung organoids, with ablations proving strictly monotonic accuracy improvements from 2D → 3D → 4D.
caveats: Focused primarily on mitochondrial dynamics imaged via specialized lattice light-sheet microscopy; broader multi-organelle and cross-microscope transfer requires additional pretraining.

scoreRationale.foundational: Pioneers 4D volumetric-temporal foundation modeling for live-cell biology, showing dynamic 4D organelle movies directly encode bioenergetic state.
scoreRationale.ripple: Opens label-free 4D phenotypic screening across drug discovery, organoid biology, and subcellular virtual-cell modeling with public model and data release.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Cell with rigorous dimensionality ablations, quantitative membrane-potential validation (R² = 0.91), and zero-shot organoid generalization.
scoreRationale.velocity: Replaces slow manual 4D microscopy annotation and invasive functional dyes with instant self-supervised embedding probes.
